answer: Each epoch a public tide of VRF beacons is published. An identity posts a small sable bond and reveals a ticket H(secret, beacon, epoch). Colliding tickets fuse those keys into one seat and slash both bonds, so an operator who reuses a secret or a shared RNG cannot multiply names. Voting weight then unlocks only after a grove of established, pairwise-unrelated peers recompute the ticket and confirm it is unique in the beacon window. Extra keys therefore require fresh uncorrelated entropy and fresh bonds, not copied tickets.
